name: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
notes: Adjacent diagnostic research across simulators, policies, tools, coding and an offline Mind2Web subset. Models choose among supplied admissible actions; they do not generate actions or execute a closed-loop browser policy in the reported evaluation. The paired probes measure selected visible facts, not complete understanding or internal causation. Pooled results are not a web-only leaderboard, and the paper reports coverage limits and label-sensitivity analyses. No benchmark release, code, data or weights were independently inspected.
summary: Pairs factual probes with next-action choices on frozen agent traces, including Mind2Web, to diagnose reading-decision gaps without closed-loop execution.
